_om: Bussen in English (Party Bus, rusj.no/en/party-bus/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The short lines (right, wrong, water …) are in data.en/tekster.json. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Guess the colour of the card you'll get.
Hjerter og ruter er røde, spar og kløver: Hearts and diamonds are red, spades and clubs are black.
Blir det nye kortet høyere eller lavere: Will the new card be higher or lower than your first card?
Aces are high. A tie counts as right.
Havner det nye kortet mellom de to først: Will the new card land between your first two cards – or outside them?
Matching either of them counts as right.
Hjerter, ruter, spar eller kløver? Den v: Hearts, diamonds, spades or clubs? The hardest of them all.
1, 2, 3 og 4 slurker – én mer for hver r: 1, 2, 3 and 4 sips – one more each round.
Begge kortene er {kort} – bare en {kort}: Both cards are {kort}s – only another {kort} counts as inside.
Innenfor eller utenfor {a} og {b}?: Inside or outside the {a} and the {b}?
Fire runder med kort – og feil svar gir: Four rounds of cards – and wrong answers mean sips. Whoever misses most rides the bus at the end.
Rød eller svart? Høyere eller lavere? In: Red or black? Higher or lower? Inside or outside? And finally: which suit? Everyone answers in turn, one card each round.
Små slurker – eller ingen. Brus, vann og: Small sips – or none. Soft drinks, water and alcohol-free count just as much, and anyone can sit out.
Den med flest feil tar bussen: fem holde: Whoever got the most wrong rides the bus: five stops of higher or lower. A miss means a new ride – but after three misses the driver gives up.
Ess er høyest. Likt teller alltid som ri: Aces are high. A tie always counts as right.
Trykket feil? «Angre – nytt kort» stokke: Tapped the wrong one? ‘Undo – new card’ shuffles the card back into the deck, and you get a new one.
Velg «Rolig» hvis dere vil ta det med ro: Choose ‘Easy’ if you want to take it slowly: 1 sip per wrong answer.
Drikk vann mellom rundene, spis noe – og: Drink water between rounds, eat something – and plan a safe way home.
Rød eller svart? Høyere eller lavere?: Red or black? Higher or lower?
Whoever misses most rides the bus.
Små slurker. Vann, brus og alkoholfritt: Small sips. Water, soft drinks and alcohol-free count just as much – and anyone can sit out.
Dere svarer etter tur, så legg gjerne mo: You answer in turn, so put the phone in the middle of the table.
Ingen slurker på deg – skål for flaksen!: No sips for you – cheers to luck!
Ingen svarte feil en eneste gang. Det ha: Nobody got a single answer wrong. We've never seen that before!
Delt førsteplass i bom – mobilen trakk: A tie for most misses – the phone drew
{feil} i fire runder. Nå venter {n} hold: {feil} in four rounds. Now {n} stops are waiting.
Gjett om neste kort er høyere eller lave: Guess whether the next card is higher or lower. Right: one stop forward.
Bom: {slurker} og tilbake til start med: Miss: {slurker} and back to the start with new cards.
Etter {n} bom gir sjåføren seg – da er d: After {n} misses the driver gives up – and you've arrived anyway.
Last ride – the driver is getting fed up.

{n} turer igjen før sjåføren gir seg..one: {n} ride left before the driver gives up.
{n} turer igjen før sjåføren gir seg..other: {n} rides left before the driver gives up.

Holdeplass {n} av {alle}. Ess er høyest,: Stop {n} of {alle}. Aces are high, a tie counts as right.
{navn} kom seg gjennom alle holdeplassen: {navn} made it through every stop on the first try. Impressive!
{navn} got off on the second try.
{navn} got off on the third try.
{navn} kjørte til sjåføren ga seg. Framm: {navn} rode until the driver gave up. Arrived anyway!
{navn} gikk av bussen – helt greit!: {navn} got off the bus – that's fine!
Drikk et glass vann før neste spill!: Have a glass of water before the next game!
Angret – kortet er stokket inn i bunken: Undone – the card has been shuffled back into the deck
Angret – du får et nytt kort på den hold: Undone – you get a new card at that stop
That's fine! You go straight to the results.
Dere går rett til kåringen med stillinge: You go straight to the results with the scores so far.
